name: TC_C09_E2E_FilterSearchAddToCart
description:
Full user journey through three endpoints:
  Step 1 — GET /filters for 'SON MOI': asserts filters are returned.
  Step 2 — GET /search for 'SON MOI': retrieves product list and picks first id.
  Step 3 — POST /add-to-cart with the first search result id.
Validates the complete upstream dependency chain — a search-result product id must be valid and addable to cart without any intermediate manual step.
